study_name: Continuous Glucose Monitoring Profiles in Healthy Nondiabetic Participants
funding_source: Leona M. and Harry B. Helmsley Charitable Trust
study_description: A multicenter, prospective observational analysis designed to establish normative continuous glucose monitoring (CGM) profiles in healthy, nondiabetic individuals across different age groups. It uses the Dexcom G6 CGM system to measure interstitial glucose values continuously over a period of up to 10 days
